messages:
eng-oncall-bot: PAGER — SmartRoutingPolicyError on prod: canary variant (model:v2-canary) returning 5xx and latency spikes. Automatic fallback to stable is sticky, observed routing oscillation between region-us-east and region-eu-west. Severity: S2.

olivia: picking this up. does the alert include error-rate + affected customers?

eng-oncall-bot: error-rate: canary 18% 5xx over 5m, overall 4xx/5xx bump +10% in us-east. 3 customers with >5% failed requests (org: fastcart, billing-api).

maya: confirmed from logs — model:v2-canary returns OOM-ish traces then rejects. stacktrace snippet: ```InferenceError: KV cache exceeded, alloc failed at attention_kernel.cu:482```

samir: canary was pushed in last rollout 2045009000 — rolled 3% traffic with sticky_fallback enabled. Looks like fallback created sticky mapping to v1-stable but only in eu region; us kept trying v2-canary because of sticky affinity+region failover mismatch.

raj: summary: canary failing -> fallback picks stable in another region -> sticky affinity keeps sending that customer to the other region -> smart-routing TTL mismatch -> client sees increased p95 and cross-region hops.

olivia: impact to customers: increased latency for sessions that hit the sticky fallback; some request failures for those still landing on canary. Need immediate mitigation: kill canary or disable sticky fallback behavior for routes using canary.

kevin: I can revert canary traffic to 0% now. Command: ```redwoodctl rollout set-variant --model my-dialogue --variant v2-canary --traffic 0```

maya: hold — before full revert, can we disable sticky fallback in policy to stop oscillation quickly? If sticky TTL cleared, routing should settle to stable in-region.

samir: policy patch ready. Patch snippet: ```{ "policy": "fallback", "sticky": false, "fallback_variant": "v1-stable", "regions": ["us-east","eu-west"]}```

olivia: good. apply the patch then monitor. samir, push the patch and then kevin will pull canary to 0 if errors persist.

samir: applying now — ```redwoodctl policy replace --id srp-4763 --file - <<EOF
{ "policy": "fallback", "sticky": false }
EOF```

eng-oncall-bot: Policy replace job accepted (job_id: j-78921). Waiting on sync across routers.

maya: observing routing table changes — sticky flag cleared for ~90% of prefixes within 30s. p95 latency dropping in eu-west, still high in us-east for some prefixes.

olivia: what's the error rate now?

eng-oncall-bot: canary 5xx dropped to 6% in last 2m (was 18%), total platform 4xx/5xx delta +2%.

kevin: still seeing steady rejections from a small host pool in us-east that are running the canary. I'll scale down canary nodes and set traffic to 0 to be safe. ```redwoodctl pool scale --pool canary-us-east --replicas 0 && redwoodctl rollout set-variant --model my-dialogue --variant v2-canary --traffic 0```

raj: doing customer comms note with CS: some sessions experienced higher latency and failures due to an experimental model rollout interacting with routing fallback. No data exposure.

cs-ops-bot: Noted — customers tagged: fastcart (impact: medium), billing-api (impact: low), travelly (impact: low). Draft sent to CS for review.

maya: quick postmortem notes while hot: root cause appears to be resource pressure (KV cache growth) in v2-canary combined with sticky fallback policies that had region affinity TTLs misaligned. Sticky affinity caused asymmetric fallback and cross-region routing, increasing latency for fallback recipients.

olivia: agreed. mitigation checklist executed: 1) disable sticky fallback (samir) 2) scale down canary & 0% traffic (kevin) 3) monitor for residual mismatches (maya).

eng-oncall-bot: All mitigations executed. Job logs: policy-replace succeeded; pool scale succeeded; rollout update succeeded.

samir: monitoring shows steady state ~3m after fixes. No new alerts firing. Recommend keeping canary traffic at 0 and run a smaller non-sticky canary later with KV cache caps.

olivia: putting incident on-call-handoff: @maya you'll take lead for remediation and follow-up. @raj please own customer comms draft.

maya: will create follow-up runbook. action items: - add circuit-breaker to canary runtime (kv-cache soft limit) - add pre-rollout check for sticky+region policy combos - add alert for cross-region-surge when fallback rate > 5%

raj: customer comms draft posted in #customer-success-drafts. CS to send a proactive note to the 3 affected orgs.

kevin: log pointers for RL investigation: ```/var/log/inference/canary/v2/oom.log``` and router traces at ```/var/log/router/smart-route/traces-2045012345.log```

olivia: tagging incident SNOOZE until full postmortem. If anyone sees regressions, @olivia please page. Thanks team :thumbsup:

eng-oncall-bot: Incident closed (post-mitigation) — duration 12m. Please fill postmortem template in #postmortems and link here.

maya: will file the postmortem now, linking runbook and mitigation commands."
